details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9570-9572 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `elif CWS_AHEAD_BY="$(_integration_branch_ahead_of_default ...)"` may take the warning branch incorrectly on shells where assignment exit status does not propagate.
  WHY: If the compare helper fails, `CWS_AHEAD_BY` is empty and the `else` warning becomes dead code; the caller still fails closed, but the compare-API warning is lost.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:513 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The prompt size log is emitted on every retry because `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_SIZE_LOGGED` is never reset between attempts.
  WHY: On a multi-attempt ladder this duplicates the warning line and adds log churn without changing behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12090 (and test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:2166) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new regression test does not exercise the full validation-complete path that performs the ahead-by recheck.
  WHY: It hard-codes `enable_validation="false"` and only asserts the finalize fallback, leaving the exact regression path untested.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1309-1320 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: If the shell is interrupted after copying the prompt file but before appending the nonce trailer, the next retry can reuse a stale prompt file.
  WHY: Cleanup only happens on the success/refusal paths, so an uncaught interrupt leaves a partial file that can defeat cache-busting.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:482-490 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A large PR diff can still push the effective judge prompt over Codex’s 1 MiB stdin envelope even though the budget state thinks it is safe.
  WHY: The requirement/metadata budget accounting does not include the later diff payload tightly enough, so `codex` can reject with `turn/start: Input exceeds the maximum length` on every retry.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2177-2183 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A transient branch-ref probe failure can flip a pinned merged state back to pending.
  WHY: The helper’s fail-open branch-existence probe can oscillate on flaky GitHub API responses, causing repeated merge-state churn.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
